moment: Bilbo's eleventy-first birthday party in the Shire
title: An Unexpected Party Crasher
story: Bilbo’s eleventy-first has everything: fireworks, cake, and one uninvited guest beneath the bench. He’s not here for the presents—just the precious.
world: Bag End, the Shire: lanterns glow beneath the Party Tree, hobbits dance and feast, and Gandalf’s fireworks light the birthday sky.

characters.name: Gollum
quips: Sneaky hobbitses! Hiding it in the cake?
We hates benches. Too many feet.
Not that shiny! The other shiny!
characters.line: Birthday presents? Where is our precious, precious?

characters.name: Bilbo Baggins
quips: An unexpected guest? How very inconvenient.
characters.line: Good gracious! I'm the birthday hobbit.

characters.name: Gandalf
quips: Leave the difficult fireworks to me.

hint.text: Look beneath the left-hand feast bench, beside a little plate.
